I don't mind crime lords, but I purely ''hate'' stupid ones|[[Rawk|"Bantha" Rawk]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 23">[[Legacy (2006) 23|''Legacy'' (2006) 23]]</ref>}}
The '''Skirmish on Iego''' was a confrontation between members of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and [[Rawk|"Bantha" Rawk's]] family which happened a short time after [[Cade Skywalker]]'s [[Skirmish at the Temple of the Sith|escape]] from the [[One Sith|Sith]]. Apparently unconnected to the [[Second Imperial Civil War|conflict]] scarring the galaxy, Black Sun sought to extort protection money from Rawk.

Rawk and his family began defending their home against the crime empire. They were assisted by the timely arrival of the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']].

However, a number of Black Sun thugs escaped and informed the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] about Skywalker's involvement.
